In Kolhapur, Maharashtra, thousands of farmers have taken to the streets. Accompanied by their cows and buffaloes, these farmers allege that the BJP and its allies are attempting to seize control of the Gokul Dairy, despite having lost the election. The matter reached the Bombay High Court, but the court declined to stay the government's decision. The election for the dairy's chairman is scheduled to take place today, November 10.
